title: DOE backs DOF move to revive kerosene, LPG tax relief

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Energy (DOE) has certified that Dubai crude oil prices have exceeded the $80-per-barrel threshold, which could lead to the suspension of excise taxes on kerosene and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) again. “The DOE finally certified the Dubai crude prices. I am immediately endorsing [to] the Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) [for] consideration the removal of excise tax for LPG and kerosene,” Finance Secretary Frederick Go told the Inquirer.
